title: 11 Years of WE
tagline: A 2000s point-and-shoot that turns into one endless 35mm film reel of a friendship.
concept: Five friends met at work in 2015 and stayed for life. Instead of a slideshow, the memory object itself: a mid-2000s digital camera powers on, flips to its LCD and fires the shutter, and the captured photo morphs into film stock that becomes a single unbroken reel of twenty-three exposures across five chapters. At the end of the roll, any friend can add their own frame.
features: Power-on, flip and shutter camera ritual
Continuous 35mm reel with live frame counter
tech: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Framer Motion, Web Audio
